description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing SMS entities within the Apache Fineract project. It provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting SMS records, as well as querying SMS messages by status and campaign ID. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for defining HTTP methods and paths, and integrates with Fineract services for security, commands handling, and data retrieval.

classes.name: SmsApiResource
classes.description: REST API endpoint for managing SMS messages within the Fineract platform, supporting CRUD operations and filtering by status and campaign.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all SMS records, with permission check.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SMS record based on the provided request data.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SMS record by its resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllSmsByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves SMS messages filtered by campaign ID and status, supporting pagination and date range filtering.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing SMS record identified by resource ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the SMS record identified by resource ID.
